## Cannon Example

This example usage of VIRGO is inspired by `SIM_cannon_analytic` from [the Trick repository](https://github.com/nasa/trick/tree/master/trick_sims/Cannon/SIM_cannon_analytic) but doesn't directly use data generated from that sim.

* `log_cannonball.csv`: Tracked Trickpy-compliant data file generated by `cannon.py`
* `scene.yml`: YAML scene file representing the `dict` VIRGO needs to build the 3D scene
* `cannon.py`: Script that simulates the cannon, then launches VIRGO using `scene.yml` and `log_cannonball.csv`
